goal: Redesign the goodplan workflow based on dogfooding pain. First design the ideal flow abstractly (independent of current skills/CLI), then translate the delta into skill and CLI changes. Seed pain points: clunky phase transitions, wrong context bundles, rigid state machine (no backward transitions), need more user steering opportunities while preserving define-up-front-then-autonomous model. Scope: whole system end-to-end (init through complete-epic). Not a rewrite — targeted improvements.
name: workflow-bug-fixes
